news.headline: FDA drops boxed warnings from 3 more estradiol patches
news.summary: HHS/FDA removed the safety boxed warnings from three estradiol transdermal patches on Oct 30, extending February's relabeling of six menopausal hormone products — the 'is estrogen safe again?' conversation your perimenopause audience (your topical-estrogen react, 356K) is already having. Lane note: HRT, not dermatology — on the shelf because estrogen-for-skin claims ride this wave.
news.her_angle: 'estrogen is back' ≠ estrogen face cream — what the patch decision does and doesn't say about topical estrogen for skin
news.source: Contemporary OB/GYN (dateline Oct 30, 2026) · HHS release Oct 30, 2026
